description: This file contains functions and logic for generating and caching form data with extra filters for dashboard charts in Apache Superset, including handling of chart-specific customizations, filters, and form data merging.

methods.name: createFilterDataMapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping of filter IDs to their corresponding filter data based on the data mask and applied filter IDs.

methods.name: extractColumnNames
methods.description: Extracts column names from an array of columns, handling string columns and objects with 'column_name' property.

methods.name: buildExistingColumnsSet
methods.description: Builds a set of existing column names from a chart's form data, considering various chart types and their specific columns.

methods.name: applyChartSpecificGroupBy
methods.description: Adjusts groupby configuration based on chart type, existing columns, and x-axis, applying chart-specific rules.

methods.name: processGroupByCustomizations
methods.description: Processes chart customizations related to grouping, filters, and sorting, returning modified form data for grouping.

methods.name: getFormDataWithExtraFilters
methods.description: Main function that merges chart form data with dashboard filters and customizations, utilizing caching for performance.
